propositions: Per-ticket runtime marker files (*/.archived, */.write.lock) are tracked in the tickets branch HEAD but should not be; gitignore patterns exist but cannot untrack already-committed files, causing routine marker churn to surface as tracked working-tree deletions that dirty git status and break plan-review head verification.
An ensure unit must remove tracked runtime markers from the git index via batched git rm --cached with a single commit; worktree copies remain untouched so local cache behavior is preserved.

The reader must self-heal missing .archived markers for net-archived tickets during list operations by re-materializing the marker file when compiled state shows archived but the marker file is absent.

After running the ensure unit, git ls-files for marker patterns must be empty, the worktree markers must still exist, exactly one commit is made, and re-running the unit makes zero commits (idempotent).
